model: Boiler with Siemens LMV3 and Yokogawa UT32A (N54 ProtoNode)
applies_to: Fulton hydronic boilers with a Siemens LMV3 burner control and a Yokogawa UT32A temperature controller, read through the N54 ProtoNode.
summary: Fulton's N54 ProtoNode reads the boiler's Siemens LMV3 burner control and its Yokogawa UT32A temperature controller over Modbus and publishes 30 objects per boiler. Objects 1-28 are the same burner data as the LMV3-only sheet; 29-30 add the outlet temperature and a writable setpoint from the UT32A.
notes: Object IDs are written (X)001-(X)030, where (X) is the LMV3's Modbus address. This list shows address 1 (1001-1030).
The sheet says the Yokogawa control sits at Modbus address X+10 but still prints its two objects as (X)029 and (X)030.
The sheet does not say which BACnet transport the gateway is set to; ProtoNode gateways are normally configured for BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP.
Objects (X)001-(X)028 match the LMV3-only N54 sheet already in the library (fulton/lmv3-protonode-n54).

integration.summary: Put the boiler in remote with the Modbus Mode BV, then run it with Operating Mode In Remote (Auto/On/Off) and the Remote Firing Rate, or write the temperature setpoint to the Yokogawa controller. Monitor burner phase, firing rate, outlet temperature, the alarm output and the LMV error code.

minimum_points.name: Boiler 1 Operating Mode In Remote
minimum_points.why: Run command in remote: 0 = Auto, 1 = On, 2 = Off

minimum_points.name: Boiler 1 Modbus Mode
minimum_points.why: Set 1 = Remote so network commands take effect

minimum_points.name: Boiler 1 Remote Firing Rate
minimum_points.why: Firing rate command, %; 20 % minimum to enable

integration.enable: Write BV (X)026 Modbus Mode = 1 (Remote). In remote, AV (X)027 Operating Mode In Remote selects 0 = Auto, 1 = On or 2 = Off, and AV (X)028 Remote Firing Rate sets the rate; the boiler is only enabled at 20 % or more. AV (X)030 Current Setpoint is the writable temperature setpoint.
setup: Object ID = boiler Modbus address followed by the three-digit point number: (X)001-(X)030. Boiler 1 = 1001-1030.
The LMV3 sits at Modbus address X and the Yokogawa UT32A at X+10 on the ProtoNode.
The sheet gives no device instance, MAC address or baud rate; those are set on the ProtoNode gateway.
gotchas: A remote firing rate below 20 % does not enable the boiler.
Error code points need the Siemens LMV manual to decode.

source.title: Hydronic LMV 3 and Yokogawa - Fulton N54 ProtoNode BACnet Network Addressing

points.name: Boiler 1 Burner Control Phase
